title: Unitec Fibres IPO Details
intro:
Unitec Fibres IPO is a book build issue of ₹34.47 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 39.17 lakh shares of ₹34.47 crore.

Unitec Fibres IPO opens for subscription on Sep 23, 2026 and closes on Sep 25, 2026. The allotment for the Unitec Fibres IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 28, 2026. Unitec Fibres IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 30, 2026.

Unitec Fibres IPO is set issue price band at ₹83 to ₹88 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,81,600 (3,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (4,800 shares), amounting to ₹4,22,400.

Smart Horizon Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Shreni Shares Ltd.

Refer to Unitec Fibres IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in February 2005, Unitec Fibres Limited is a manufacturer of Recycled Polyester Staple Fibre (RPSF), producing sustainable polyester fibres from recycled PET flakes, PET chips, and other post-consumer polyester waste. The company supplies RPSF to industries such as automobiles, home furnishings, and textiles, where its products are used in carpets, roof liners, trunks, sofas, curtains, and spinning applications.

The company operates two manufacturing facilities at the M.I.D.C. Tarapur Industrial Area, Maharashtra, with a combined installed production capacity of 27,984 MTPA. It is also establishing a third manufacturing unit in Valsad, Gujarat to expand production capacity. Unitec Fibres follows stringent quality standards and holds ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, OEKO-TEX®, and Global Recycled Standard (GRS) certifications, reflecting its commitment to quality, environmental sustainability, and recycled product manufacturing.

Led by an experienced management team with over two decades of industry expertise, the company focuses on sustainable manufacturing, efficient production processes, and long-term customer relationships.

As of March 31, 2026, Unitec Fibres employed 171 permanent personnel across production, quality, maintenance, finance, procurement, dispatch, import-export, human resources, and administrative functions.

faqs.question: How to apply in Unitec Fibres IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Unitec Fibres IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Unitec Fibres IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Unitec Fibres IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Unitec Fibres IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.answer: Unitec Fibres IPO lot size is 1600 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,81,600 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Unitec Fibres IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Unitec Fibres IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Unitec Fibres IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Unitec Fibres IPO will be done on Monday, September 28, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Sep 29, 2026 . Check the Unitec Fibres IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Unitec Fibres IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Sep 30, 2026 .
